summary: Three-stage session validation guard. Computes a short value from the global at 0x005EA510 via ShortComputation_c910, then returns 1 only if the this+0x4 enable flag is non-zero, the computed value is non-zero, and sub_54C0E0(computed) is non-zero; otherwise returns 0.

operations.description: ShortComputation_c910 reads the global dword_5EA510 and computes a short value used by the subsequent guards.
If the this+0x4 enable/state flag is zero, return 0 immediately.
If the value computed by ShortComputation_c910 is zero, return 0 immediately.
sub_54C0E0 validates or checks the computed short value.
If sub_54C0E0(computed value) is zero, return 0 immediately.
Return 1 only when all three guards pass; this function is invoked from sub_4C8FC0.

unresolved: Semantic role of the value produced by ShortComputation_c910 and of the check performed by sub_54C0E0 is not established by the packet.
